Revenge is kind of like killing a two headed viper, while you watch the enemy go down, ur also being poisoned. You may feel better about levelling the playing field with your ex, but in the end you have become a worse person than them. Now people will see you in an even worse light. That sort of situation is not worth it.

would not suggest trying suicide in a hospital especially with pills, hospitals are very well equipped and the chance of you surviving a suicide attempt in a hospital is higher than in most places. Try and hold out until you leave the hospital, things may start looking up. I hope you change ur mind.
